name: TrustRadius TrustQuote
description: Field-level structure of a licensed TrustRadius review excerpt, as returned by GET /trustquotes (operationId trustquotes_get). Derived field-for-field from #/components/schemas/TrustQuotes in the provider-published OpenAPI. Types and nesting are the provider's; nothing is added.
envelope: bare JSON array of TrustQuote objects (no wrapper, no total count)

fields.name: isSummary
fields.description: Whether this is a summary excerpt rather than a verbatim pull.

fields.name: isAnonymous
fields.description: Whether the reviewer chose anonymity. When true, reviewer identity in `user` must not be rendered.

fields.name: taggedreviewStatus
fields.description: Tagging state of the underlying review.

fields.name: allTags
fields.description: Tag ids applied to this quote; join against GET /tags.

fields.name: allTagNames
fields.description: Tag display names, parallel to allTags.

fields.name: review.id
fields.description: Identifier of the underlying published review.

fields.name: review.url
fields.description: Canonical link back to the published review on TrustRadius.

fields.name: review.rating
fields.description: Numeric rating carried by the underlying review.

fields.name: review.editedDate
fields.description: When the review was last edited.

fields.name: user.name
fields.description: Reviewer name. Suppress when isAnonymous is true.

fields.name: user.pictureUrl
fields.description: Reviewer avatar. Suppress when isAnonymous is true.
